---
title: "Instacart Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
data(instacart)
instacart = 
  instacart |> 
  select(product_name, aisle, department, order_hour_of_day, reordered)
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Time of Day Items Are Ordered, by Department

```{r}
set.seed(1)
instacart |> 
  filter(!department %in% c("missing","other")) |> 
  sample_n(10000) |> 
  mutate(department = fct_reorder(department, order_hour_of_day)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    y = ~ order_hour_of_day, 
    color = ~department, 
    type = "box", 
    colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Department", tickangle = 60),
    yaxis = list(title = "Hour of day order was placed")
  )
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Snack Popularity vs. Reorder Rate 

```{r}
instacart |> 
  filter(department == "snacks") |> 
  group_by(product_name, aisle) |> 
  summarize(
    n_orders = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered), 
    .groups = "drop") |> 
  filter(n_orders >= 100) |> 
  mutate(text_label = str_c(
    "Product: ", product_name,
    "\nOrders: ", n_orders,
    "\nReorder rate: ", round(reorder_rate, 2)
  )) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n_orders, y = ~reorder_rate, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~aisle, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis"
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of times ordered"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Proportion reordered")
  )
```

### Number of Snack Items Ordered, by Aisle

```{r}
instacart |> 
  filter(department == "snacks") |> 
  count(aisle) |> 
  mutate(aisle = fct_reorder(aisle, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~aisle, y = ~n, color = ~aisle, type = "bar", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Aisle", tickangle = 60),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of items ordered"))
```
